## Verdict

Critical authorization hole — do not merge until account lookup is gated to support staff (or equivalent).

## Findings

| # | Severity | File | Summary |
|---|----------|------|---------|
| 1 | 🚨 critical | `src/routes/account.ts:8` | Any authenticated caller can look up any account via `body.accountId` (IDOR) |

## Notes

`auth(req)` only establishes the caller; nothing in this diff checks a staff/support role before honoring a client-supplied `accountId`. The comment documents intent for support tools, but the code applies the override to every authenticated request.

`auth` / `db` are imported and not present in this tree, so role helpers could exist elsewhere — if they do, this handler still does not call them.

## Recommendation

**request-changes**
